description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named CartScreen for displaying and managing a shopping cart in a mobile app. It includes the UI for listing cart items, showing totals, and proceeding to checkout, along with a helper widget for editing item quantities.

classes.name: CartScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays cart items, calculates totals, and navigates to checkout.

classes.name: _Totals
classes.description: A widget that displays subtotal, delivery fee, and total amounts.

classes.name: _QtyDialog
classes.description: A stateful widget that provides a dialog for updating item quantity.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the CartScreen widget tree, including the list of items and the checkout button.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the _Totals widget displaying the subtotal, delivery, and total amounts.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the _QtyDialog widget allowing quantity adjustments.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the _QtyDialogState with the current quantity.
